patterns.note: Extreme vertical whitespace is used to separate content, giving a very airy and uncluttered feel, with content often centered or left-aligned within a generous content column.
A single, elegant serif typeface is used for all primary text content, including the oversized hero heading and the footer contact details, creating a strong typographic identity.
A high-contrast palette of black text on a white background is accented by a vibrant, solid red for interactive elements and a prominent top banner.

A full-width, solid red promotional bar at the very top of the page disappears completely on scroll, and simultaneously, the main navigation (logo and links) becomes sticky at the top, changing from an initial transparent state to having a solid white background.

technique_notes: The main navigation bar is initially transparent and positioned relative to the top of the page, then transitions to a fixed position with a solid white background as the user scrolls past the initial viewport, while a full-width promotional top bar simultaneously slides out of view. No complex Lottie animations or scroll-triggered reveals are visually apparent in the provided sequence.
Content sections are defined primarily by large amounts of empty space rather than distinct background colors or dividers, creating a sense of calm and focus on the typography.
The primary visual hierarchy is established through extreme variations in font size and weight, with a dominant, oversized serif heading immediately capturing attention.

design_tokens.type_scale: Very oversized, elegant serif hero text (~4-5x body size) with a classic, readable serif for body and smaller, clean sans-serif for navigation and utility text.
design_tokens.spacing: Extremely airy, particularly in the hero section, with generous line-heights and paragraph spacing, creating a sense of luxury and focus.

standout: The site's standout feature is its bold commitment to extreme typographic minimalism. It eschews imagery and complex layouts, instead relying almost entirely on the elegant presentation of a single, oversized serif typeface against vast white space to convey its brand and message, making the typography itself the primary visual and emotional driver.
